title: GTA 6 Is Out: Your Console Runs It at 30 FPS
caption:
GTA 6 is out, and Rockstar targets 30 frames per second on PS5, PS5 Pro and Xbox Series X|S, with no 60 fps mode at launch. The PS5 Pro adds PSSR upscaling and ray-traced shadows no other console gets: better looks, same frame rate.
Would you trade 30 fps for those visuals, or wait for a 60 fps patch?

Sources: Rockstar Games, Shacknews, Insider Gaming
